note: The rules behind NotificationAlertSettings: how its rows read a person's notification preferences (quiet hours, preview, behaviour while another device is in use) and what a weekday pick writes back. The value is the protocol's own shape: minutes after midnight in device local time, and weekdays as bits (bit 0 Monday … bit 6 Sunday, 0 every day). The four kits run this table against their helpers (Vue notification-alert contract, Flutter, SwiftUI and Compose NotificationAlertSettings helpers).

rules.rows: Three sections: quiet hours (the switch, and while it is on start, end, repeat and the allow-mentions switch), preview, and the other-device behaviour. Rows are keyed as below so a settings page keeps its own rows on other keys.
rules.time: A minute of the day reads HH:mm, 24-hour, zero-padded; minutes are taken modulo 1440.
rules.end: The end reads as the next day when it is not after the start (end < start crosses midnight, end == start is the whole day).
rules.weekdays: 0 and 127 both mean every day. Turning a day on or off starts from all seven days when the mask is 0; a result with all seven days is written 0; a pick that would leave no day changes nothing.
rules.summary: Every day, Weekdays (Monday to Friday), Weekends (Saturday and Sunday), otherwise the days in week order joined by the kit's list separator.
